blurb: LAN co-op tower defense for 2–4 defenders, each on their own screen. Shared gold, build anytime (+25% mid-wave), repair at 50%. Base has 20 HP.
keys: Run python3 server.py in 2players/bastion/, then open the printed URL on each device. · move WASD/arrows/tap · 123 + E build · Enter wave · 🎮 pad supported
title: Bastion Bros LAN
